This is a safety-tier review. I read the full diff and checked the four changed NC blocks line by line.
The local trial merge is `d1ab71ef9bf80aabc8b7ba2042e5dda4c0b081af`, against upstream main `e902ee488e2d80cf84267d55898489e10400a073`.
Its first parent is the PR head above. The merge has no conflicts.

Upstream main advanced to `ec314174e3afe7d88524c6cecb4b4afe871dd65d` during this review.
Its review rules did not change. These test results cover the recorded `e902ee4` base; I did not rebuild the newer base.

Requested before merge:

1. **Bound every radial peck loop by its full travel.** Class: numeric termination.
   [`crates/motion/src/drilling/cross.rs:236`](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/blob/46edb352143d5ce1806f55f67a88c5d98a9f1b87/crates/motion/src/drilling/cross.rs#L236) changes `depth` to the material depth.
   The guard at line 260 also uses that value, but the loop still starts at `p.r_d`.
   With a 2 mm drill, floor `-8`, explicit `Peck`, default peck and `r_d = 30000`, the PR returns 10,005 moves.
   Main refuses this input with `peck plan unusable`.
   With `r_d = 1e20`, the PR hangs because subtracting the step cannot change `t`.
   A five-second timeout stopped the running test. Both probes pass immediately with main's unchanged `cross.rs`.
   Keep the material depth for Auto. Use the full R-plane travel for the iteration limit, and refuse a step that makes no progress.
   Pin both cases. This rule must cover explicit pecks and Auto pecks.

2. **Invalidate caches made by the old generator.** Class: cached generator output.
   [`crates/motion/src/drilling/cycle.rs:92`](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/blob/46edb352143d5ce1806f55f67a88c5d98a9f1b87/crates/motion/src/drilling/cycle.rs#L92) changes Auto's emitted cycles and moves.
   The Auto parameter digest stays unchanged. The trial merge also leaves `GENERATOR_OUTPUT_VERSION` at `1`.
   A saved cache from current main can therefore remain current and post the old cycle without regeneration.
   Current main's [rule at the stamp](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/blob/e902ee488e2d80cf84267d55898489e10400a073/crates/app/src/operation/stamp.rs#L20) requires a version bump for this output change.
   Bump `GENERATOR_OUTPUT_VERSION`. Add a saved-Auto-cache test that reads Stale and blocks posting until regeneration.

3. **Add before/after UI screenshots to the PR body.** Class: UI review evidence.
   [`crates/ui/src/operations.rs:59`](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/blob/46edb352143d5ce1806f55f67a88c5d98a9f1b87/crates/ui/src/operations.rs#L59) adds a visible cycle choice.
   The body has no before/after screenshots. Link the old and new cycle combo.
   Keep the images on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch.

4. **List the changed program under `Goldens moved`.** Class: recorded program evidence.
   [`examples/catalog/2d/first-part/first-part.nc:487`](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/blob/46edb352143d5ce1806f55f67a88c5d98a9f1b87/examples/catalog/2d/first-part/first-part.nc#L487) changes four drill blocks.
   The body explains the change under `Effect on programs`, but it has no required `Goldens moved` list.
   Add that section and name the exact NC path. State the four `G83 Q6` to `G73 Q18` changes.

- Light lane: **6 steps passed, 11 light tests passed, 0 failed, 0 stalled**, 23.8 minutes. The release prebuild passed.
  `motion light: lib` passed 7 tests. `adaptive_troch_island`, `adaptive_troch_neck`, `adaptive_troch_parallel`, and `app light: pocket_pass_start` each passed 1 test.

Extra suites run:

- The catalog and golden checks ran by name. They cover the changed catalog program.
- No importer source or STEP fixture changed, so the extra kernel importer suites do not apply.

Mutations and safety probes:

I used copies under `/tmp/review-4316-probe`. I did not edit tracked sources.
The unmodified PR copies passed all four new drilling tests before and after the checks.

| Check | Mutated result | Restored result |
|---|---|---|
| Restore the old axial `p.r_z - bottom` Auto depth | Red: the spot test gets `[Peck, Peck]` instead of `[Drill, Drill]` | Green |
| Map explicit `Deep` to `CycleKind::Peck` | Red: the Deep test gets `[Peck, Peck]` instead of `[Deep, Deep]` | Green |

| Radial progress probe at R=1e20 | PR source timed out after the test started, exit 124 | Green with upstream main's unchanged `cross.rs` |

The NC comparison changes only four cycle words and peck values. Coordinates, depths, R planes, feeds and retracts stay unchanged.
Full heavy lanes were not run. Current upstream law does not require them for this P7 PR.
The author's heavy result names a pre-existing swarf failure in #4315; I did not use that result as my own test record.
A real machine was not exercised.

The environment has no `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`. The unique job identity above uses this review request's PR number.
I left the labels, title and draft flag unchanged, as requested. The review worktree and branch remain in place.
A maintainer will approve and merge by hand after the findings are fixed.

Reviewer: m3 pool job review-4316-r2, Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5), mkinney; did not write or refresh this PR.

Needs changes before merge. Label: `needs-rework`.

This is a re-review of the new head. The PR changes posted G-code and the Auto cycle choice, so this is a SAFETY-tier review.
All checks ran locally on this host (macOS arm64, Apple M3 Max). No GitHub runner was used.
The trial merge is `9155038083fd45dfde59654e6ad2a1ae944d1d5b`. Its first parent is the PR head, and its second parent is upstream main `b2afd64ed3a3cd465c57aefbd4b80938bd6cd8c6`. The merge has no conflicts.

## Earlier findings (review on 46edb352)

1. **Radial peck loop bound** - fixed by 7e5349799. The budget reads `r_d - bottom`, and a step with no progress is refused. `a_far_radial_standoff_is_refused_by_the_peck_budget` passes. My mutation (budget back to the material depth) makes it red.
2. **Stale caches after the Auto change** - fixed by 708d6e705. `GENERATOR_OUTPUT_VERSION` is 2. `a_drill_cache_saved_before_the_2443_bump_reads_stale_and_does_not_post` passes. My mutation (version back to 1) makes `deburr_cache_stamp::an_automatic_legacy_deburr_cache_keeps_its_stamp` red, so the bump is pinned. Note: the new stamp test alone stays green under that mutation, because `stamp_before` uses `GENERATOR_OUTPUT_VERSION - 1`. This is the same design as the #3704 test, and it is not a finding.
3. **Before/after screenshots** - fixed. The body links `2443/cycle-combo-before.png` and `2443/cycle-combo-after.png` on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch. The two files exist.
4. **`Goldens moved` section** - fixed. I checked `examples/catalog/2d/first-part/first-part.nc` line by line. Only the four drill blocks change: `G83 ... Q6.` becomes `G73 ... Q18.` X, Y, Z, R and F do not change. The hole is 12.803 mm deep in material on a 6 mm drill (about 2.1 x d), so `G73` agrees with the Auto law.

## Requested before merge

1. **NEW blocker: `drilling_cross_box::a_cylinder_stock_chain_matches_its_numeric_reference` fails on the PR head.** Class: a cycle choice at an exact threshold depends on float roundoff.
   - Commit d5cd91ede (item 6) introduced this. The earlier review could not see it.
   - The test is red on the bare PR head `4cbc56ee9` and on the trial merge. It is green on bare upstream main `b2afd64ed`. The body says that it passes; on this host it does not.
   - Failure text:
     ```
     panicked at crates/app/tests/cross_chain_reference/mod.rs:78:5:
     assertion `left == right` failed: cylinder case 0: ordered move count
       left: 19
      right: 43
     ```
   - Cause: in the three-station case, the mouth is at r 10 and the floor is 6 mm deep. The d40 bar puts 10 mm of stock over the mouth. The drill is 4 mm (the reference pecks 4 mm at a time). The new depth at [`crates/motion/src/drilling/cross.rs:237`](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/blob/4cbc56ee909a3803ab49f9246e7d4ec6842c1cc8/crates/motion/src/drilling/cross.rs#L237) is `start_d(h, p.stock_r) - bottom` = 10 + 6 = 16 mm. This is exactly `4 * d`. `auto_kind` at `crates/motion/src/drilling/hole.rs:270` tests `depth <= 4.0 * diameter`. Thus a roundoff of `stock_r` (the reference chain starts at `25.000000000000004`) decides between the chip-break peck (19 moves) and the full retract (43 moves). The same project can post different cycles on different systems.
   - Fix the class, not this one case. Make the Auto thresholds stable against roundoff, for example compare with a small tolerance in `auto_kind`, so that the result is the same on every system. Then record the reference chain that the new law gives (or move the fixture off the boundary), and list the change under `Goldens moved`.
2. **New top-level test binary without a reason.** Class: test layout law (AGENTS.md "New tests join a directory suite", #3187).
   - `crates/app/tests/drill_auto_material.rs` is a new top-level binary. The body gives no one-line reason for it.
   - Move the two tests into an existing directory suite, or add the reason line to the body.

## Results on the trial merge

- Quick plan (`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`, 372 steps). I ran each step: through the gate for motion, ui and `app suites: lib`, and as `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test ...` batches for the app suites (the gate's `--only` takes exact step names).
  - motion: build, `lib`, `center_cut_owed`, `cross_invariance`, `deburr_filters` - pass.
  - app: build and `lib` pass. 349 of the 350 other app suites pass. 1 suite fails: `drilling_cross_box` (6 passed, 1 failed; finding 1).
  - ui: build, `lib` and 12 suites pass. The host has a GPU (Apple M3 Max via Metal).
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Light lane (`cargo xtask gate light`): 6 steps (release build, `motion light: lib`, `adaptive_troch_island`, `adaptive_troch_neck`, `adaptive_troch_parallel`, `app light: pocket_pass_start`), 0 failed, 0 stalled, 13.6 min.
- Heavy lanes: not run. They are not a review condition (AGENTS.md "Heavy lanes at review"). The author's heavy run on this head reports 51 steps and 0 failed.

## Extra suites run

- `example_catalog` (44 passed, 4 ignored), `example_catalog_adaptive`, `example_catalog_edge_work`: pass.
- `golden_cl` (34 passed), `solid_law_goldens`, `recorded_post_streams`, `first_part_programs`, `sim`, `deburr_cache_stamp`, `wire_stamp`, `mcp` (57 passed), `drill_auto_material`, `drilling_cross_stock`: pass.
- No importer source or STEP fixture changed. The kernel STEP suites do not apply.

## Mutations (safety tier)

| Mutation | Result | Restored |
|---|---|---|
| `cross.rs`: peck budget reads `depth`, not `r_d - bottom` | Red: `a_far_radial_standoff_is_refused_by_the_peck_budget` (Peck at R 30000 returns a toolpath) | Green |
| `cycle.rs`: `material_top` ignores the caller's readings | Red: `auto_counts_the_material_over_the_mouth` (`[Drill]`, expected `[Peck]`) | Green |
| `stamp.rs`: `GENERATOR_OUTPUT_VERSION` back to 1 | Red: `deburr_cache_stamp::an_automatic_legacy_deburr_cache_keeps_its_stamp` | Green |
| `drill_prior.rs`: never read the program ahead | Red: `drill_auto_material::stock_the_program_ahead_cut_away_is_not_depth` (`Peck`, expected `Drill`) | Green |

All four mutations were reverted. The tree was clean before each test run on the PR code.

## What looks good

- The axial law reads the higher of the mouth and the material over it, clamped to the R plane. The plunge and the R word do not change.
- The app reads the program ahead only where raw stock stands above a mouth. This keeps the cost low.
- The setup sheet names the cycle from a current cache and says `auto` when no current cache exists. It does not guess.
- `Deep` is appended at combo index 10 and digest byte 10, so older operations keep their stamps.

A real machine was not exercised. The labels on the PR were `P7` only. I set `needs-rework`. The PR stays ready (AGENTS.md: a review finding does not make a PR a draft again).

1. **Auto cycle at an exact limit depends on float roundoff** - fixed in b069c4477.
   - The fix closes the class. `auto_kind` compares the two limits (1 x d and 4 x d) with `AUTO_TOL` = 1e-6 mm. Both limits stay inclusive, as the law says ("up to four diameters").
   - The axial cycle, the radial cycle and the drill page all call `auto_kind`. Thus the same project gives the same cycle on each system.
   - The pin is `drilling::tests_auto_depth::an_auto_limit_reads_the_same_under_roundoff` (motion lib). It moves depths a few ULP over and under each limit, and it moves a radial stock radius of 25 by roundoff.
   - Mutation: with `AUTO_TOL = 0.0` the pin is red (`4 x d under roundoff: 1.6000000000000014e1`, `Deep`, expected `Peck`). Restored, it is green.
   - The cylinder reference `THREE_STATION` in `crates/app/tests/cross_chain_reference/mod.rs` is recorded again. It reads 16 mm on a 4 mm drill, so Auto now gives the chip-break peck (19 moves). It is listed under "Goldens moved" in the body. `drilling_cross_box` passes (7 of 7).
   - Note: on this host `drilling_cross_box` stays green under the mutation, because this host reads the depth at or under 16. The motion pin adds the roundoff itself, so it is red on each host.
2. **New top-level test binary** - fixed in 44f83e433.
   - `crates/app/tests/drill_auto_material.rs` moved to `crates/app/tests/drill_prior/auto_material.rs`. The `drill_prior` suite includes it with `#[path]`.
